title: A practical checklist for choosing managed WordPress hosting
audience: Site owners comparing hosting options before a migration
readerOutcome: Identify must-have requirements, trade-offs and questions to ask each shortlisted host.
outline: When managed hosting is and is not appropriate
conversionFit: Offer Kinsta as one option only after explaining who benefits and who should consider alternatives.

title: Plan a WordPress hosting migration without skipping the checks
audience: WordPress maintainers preparing to change hosting providers
readerOutcome: Build a backup, staging, DNS, verification and rollback plan.
conversionFit: Mention hosting support only where it helps the reader's migration requirements.

title: Compare WordPress hosting costs beyond the headline price
audience: Small teams estimating the full cost of operating a WordPress site
readerOutcome: Compare provider quotes using the same workload, support and maintenance assumptions.
outline: When a cheaper option makes sense
conversionFit: Link only after a balanced budget comparison; never invent prices or savings.
